LanguageData.MUGB_FuelTabAllowWoodDesc: Allows this goblin building to use wood for automatic and manual refueling.
LanguageData.MUGB_FuelTabAllowCoalDesc: Allows this goblin building to use Medieval Overhaul coal for automatic and manual refueling.
